Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.azure.auth

Record Class StorageAccount

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.azure.auth.StorageAccount
Record Components:
name - the account name
key - the account key (Base64)
protocol - https or http
endpointSuffix - e.g. core.windows.net
public record StorageAccount(String name, String key, String protocol, String endpointSuffix) extends Record
A storage account from a connection string such as the function app's AzureWebJobsStorage, and the SharedKey signature of requests to it.

    • sharedKey

      public String sharedKey(String method, String path, Map<String,String> query, long contentLength, String contentType, Map<String,String> msHeaders)
      The Authorization header of a request, signed with SharedKey (Blob, Queue and File services, version 2009-09-19 and later).
      Parameters:
      method - the HTTP method
      path - the URL path, e.g. /orders/messages
      query - the query parameters, may be empty
      contentLength - the body length; 0 signs an empty length
      contentType - the content type, or an empty string
      msHeaders - the x-ms-* headers that are sent
      Returns:
      the header value SharedKey <account>:<signature>

    • tableSharedKey

      public String tableSharedKey(String method, String contentType, String date, String path)
      The Authorization header of a request to the Table service, signed with SharedKey.
      Parameters:
      method - the HTTP method
      contentType - the content type, or an empty string
      date - the value of the x-ms-date header
      path - the encoded URL path as sent, e.g. /orders(PartitionKey='a',RowKey='b')
      Returns:
      the header value SharedKey <account>:<signature>

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
